paper.title: Little Red Dots: Rapidly Growing Black Holes Reddened by Extended Dusty Flows

result.summary: 本文针对 JWST 发现的“小红点”（LRD）的 V 形光谱能量分布（SED）提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 SED 模型，认为其由被延展尘埃介质遮蔽的 AGN 辐射所解释 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。模型假设 AGN 的典型 SED 入射到具有类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境消光律的延展尘埃介质中，紫外-光学部分由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。在红外波段，延展的尘埃与气体分布（γ<1，ρ∝r^-γ）使较冷尘埃主导辐射，将能量峰值从近红外移到中红外，从而产生与 JWST MIRI 观测一致的平坦红外 SED [S1.p6][S5.p2]。作者指出这种密度结构可能来自星系核早期组装过程中流入与流出的共存，并可能解释 LRD 为何优先出现在红移大于 4 的年轻宇宙中 [S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是 LRD 特征性 V 形 SED 的起源，即其静止系光学红色连续谱与紫外蓝色（或平坦）过剩分别来自尘埃遮蔽的 AGN、星暴星系、未被遮蔽的星系光还是 AGN 散射光 [S1.p2]。作者指出，LRD 中超过 70% 显示宽氢巴尔末线，表明存在大质量黑洞，其宇宙体积丰度显著高于地面类星体巡天预期，对类星体光度函数演化、宇宙再电离以及高红移黑洞快速自旋等具有重要意义 [S1.p1]。此外，MIRI 观测显示多数 LRD 在 F1800W 未被探测到，且探测到的源其 SED 从静止系光学到近红外趋于平坦，这与热尘埃再发射导致的极红 SED 预期相矛盾，从而引发对尘埃遮蔽 AGN 情景的质疑 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Spectroscopic observations on photometrically identified LRDs have revealed that more than 70% exhibit broad hydrogen Balmer lines, indicating the presence of massive black holes (BHs).

The abundance of these AGNs in cosmic volume is significantly higher than what is expected from ground-based quasar surveys, and provides insights on the cosmological evolution of quasar luminosity functions, the impact on cosmic reionization, and the implications to rapid spins of these high-redshift BHs
Despite their significance, the properties of these newly identified LRDs remain puzzling, particularly concerning the origin of their characteristic v-shaped spectral energy distribution (SED).

Observational studies using SED template fitting suggested that the red optical part could either be due to dust-reddened AGNs or starburst galaxies, while the blue UV component might represent light from unobscured galaxies or scattered light from embedded AGNs.

Data from the JADES, COSMOS-Web and PRIMER-COSMOS surveys show that most LRDs are not detected in the JWST/MIRI F1800W bands, and even for the detected sources, the MIRI SEDs tend to flatten from the rest-frame optical to the near-infrared (NIR) at 1–3 $\mu$ m
Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.

method.text: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的 LRD SED 模型：假设具有典型 SED 的 AGN 入射辐射嵌入延展尘埃介质中，其消光律类似猎户座星云或某些 AGN 环境，紫外-光学谱由尘埃衰减的 AGN 辐射描述，通过灰消光在 λ<3000 Å 建立平坦紫外谱形，无需额外恒星辐射或 AGN 散射光 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。在红外波段，模型采用径向密度分布 ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^-γ，通过平衡尘埃加热与热发射冷却计算尘埃温度，并计算尘埃再发射光度，其中外半径由柱密度约束使 AV≈3 mag 确定 [S3.p3][S3.p4]。模型还考虑辐射压反馈效应，将 sublimation 半径替换为光学深度为 1 的光球半径，使热尘埃被推至更大半径并变冷，从而将 NIR 发射移至 MIR [S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.

The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission, composed of a red optical continuum and a UV excess established through gray extinction. There is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.

The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission with $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag, featuring a red optical continuum at $\lambda>4000~{\rm\AA}$ and a flat UV spectral shape established through a gray extinction curve at $\lambda<3000~{\rm\AA}$, due to the absence of small-size grains.

we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$, where $\rho_{0}$ is the gas density at the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$, and the power-law index ranges $0<\gamma<2$.

where $0<\Omega\leq 4\pi$ is the solid angle covered by dust and $r_{\rm out}$ is determined by a constraint on the column density so that the visual extinction reaches $A_{\rm V}\simeq 3$ mag to reproduce the characteristic red continuum spectra of LRDs in the rest-frame optical bands
In our model, feedback effects are incorporated by substituting $r_{\rm in}$ with $r_{\rm ph}$ in Equation ( 3).
As a result of the feedback, hot dust just behind the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$ is pushed to larger radii and becomes cooler, shifting the NIR emission to MIR.

experiments.text: 论文通过 SED 建模与已有观测数据比较来验证模型：在紫外-光学部分，采用去除宿主星系和尘埃贡献的低红移类星体复合 SED 作为入射通量，假设 AV=3 mag，并叠加 z~5.5 和 z=7.5 的 LRD 堆叠测光数据进行对比 [S2.p4][S2.p5]。在红外部分，模型计算不同气体密度 n0（1 至 10^3 cm^-3）和密度斜率 γ 下的 SED，并与 JADES 和 COSMOS-Web 的 LRD 堆叠测光数据以及 SCUBA 和 ALMA 非探测上限比较 [S3.p6][S3.p7]。作者还以 z=6、Lbol=5×10^45 erg s^-1 的 LRD 为例，展示符合 MIRI F770W/F1800W 和 ALMA 约束的 SED 模型，并与 AGN 热尘埃环模板（Torus model、Apr 220、Mrk 231）比较 [S4.SS1.p5]。

evidence.quote: We here adopt the composite SED of low- $z$ quasars from as the incident flux.

For all the cases, we assume a visual extinction $A_{\mathrm{V}}=3$ mag and normalize the attenuated fluxes at $\lambda=4000~{\rm\AA}$. As reference, we overlay photometric SED data obtained from stacking LRD samples at $z\sim 5.5$ (orange) and $z=7.5$ (blue).

For comparison, we overlay the stacking photometric data of observed LRDs reported by the JADES survey and the COSMOS-Web survey. Furthermore, the upper bounds of the mid- to far-IR flux densities due to non-detection in SCUBA and ALMA bands are shown

In the left panel of Figure 4, we show the dependence of the SED shape on the gas density ( $1\leq n_{0}/{\rm cm}^{-3}\leq 10^{3}$) at the sublimation radius, while the slope of its radial profile is fixed to $\gamma=0$.
We consider a LRD at $z=6$ with a bolometric luminosity of $L_{\mathrm{bol}}=5\times 10^{45}$ erg s -1.
For comparison, we also show the SED templates of AGN hot dust tori (Torus model), Apr 220, and Mrk 231 provided by, for which the same bolometric luminosity is assumed.

findings.text: 模型结果表明，采用猎户座星云消光律的 SED 能再现 LRD 特征性 V 形 SED，在 λ≳3000-4000 Å 产生红色连续谱，并在紫外波段保持 β_UV~-2 的平坦谱形，而其他消光律则无法维持紫外过剩 [S2.p5]。在红外波段，当密度 n0 高达 10^3 cm^-3 时，模型产生过亮的静止系近红外发射，与 MIRI F770W 约束不符；而 n0=10 和 100 cm^-3 时，SED 形状与观测一致，能量峰值移至 λ~20-50 μm 的远红外 [S3.p7][S3.p8]。当密度降至 n0=1 cm^-3 时，红外 SED 峰值在 λ~100 μm 并超过 ALMA 上限 [S3.p8]。综合 β_opt/NIR<-1 和 T_out≥30 K 约束，允许的参数空间约为 10^{2.9γ+0.83}≲n0/cm^-3≲10^3，适用于 γ<0.8 [S4.SS1.p4]。此外，模型估计的尘埃质量与 NIRCam 图像估计值一致 [S4.SS1.p6]。

evidence.quote: The attenuated flux density reproduces a red continuum component at $\lambda\gtrsim 3000-4000~{\rm\AA}$ with a slope of $\beta_{\rm opt}\gtrsim 0$

Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$. In contrast, other models result in strongly attenuated flux that fails to maintain a UV excess.

When the density is as high as $n_{0}=10^{3}~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the outer edge of the obscuring material is located at $r_{\rm out}\gtrsim 30~r_{\rm in}$, where the dust temperature ranges from $T_{\rm dust}\simeq 1500~{\rm K}$ to $\sim 200~{\rm K}$.
However, this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.

For the cases with $n_{0}=10$ and $100~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the SED shapes from the optical band to $\lambda=2-3~\mu{\rm m}$ agree to the observed spectra of LRDs (or their stacked photometry based on the F444W and F770W filters for $z\simeq 6$ LRDs), and also the peak energy is shifted to the FIR band at $\lambda\sim 20-50~\mu{\rm m}$.
As the density decreases to $n_{0}=1~{\rm cm}^{-3}$, the IR SED peaks at $\lambda\sim 100~\mu{\rm m}$ and exceeds the upper bounds obtained by ALMA observations.
Here, the density range is approximated as $10^{2.9\gamma+0.83}\lesssim n_{0}/({\rm cm}^{-3})\lesssim 10^{3},$ (5) which is valid $\gamma<0.8$.
These results agree well to the mean value of the dust mass $\langle M_{\rm dust}\rangle\simeq 1.6^{+4.8}_{-0.9}\times 10^{4}~M_{\odot}$ estimated using NIRCam images of LRDs.

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，LRD 为何在 z>4 出现且具有统一的 AV=3 mag 消光水平，目前没有明确答案，只能给出推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。模型假设全天覆盖（C=1），但该值需在 LRD 与未遮蔽 AGN 的相对宇宙丰度及 C 对 Eddington 比等 AGN 性质的依赖被更好理解后才能确定 [S3.p4]。关于尘埃散射导致变异性减弱的情景，作者表示更详细的定量分析将在未来工作中探索 [S4.SS3.p2]。此外，作者强调其方法并不排除 LRD 中存在宿主星系，只是表明仅关注 AGN 的 SED 模型能成功捕捉 LRD 的特征光谱性质 [S4.SS2.p5]。

evidence.quote: There is a critical question: Why do LRDs emerge at $z>4$ with a uniform extinction level of $A_{\rm V}=3$ mag? There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.

In our calculation, we assume a full-sky covering case (i.e., $C\equiv\Omega/4\pi=1$), while this value will be determined when the relative cosmic abundance between LRDs and unobscured AGNs and the dependence of $C$ on the AGN properties such as the Eddington ratio are better understood for LRDs.
A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.

Here, we emphasize that our approach does not rule out the existence of host galaxies in LRDs, but demonstrates that the SED model focusing only on AGNs successfully captures the characteristic spectral properties of LRDs
